frozen_note: Four protocol profiles and five churn kinds are frozen before the live run. Timer budgets stay separate. A classic-group pass is not evidence for KIP-848 or share. Older brokers stay explicit.

share_analogues.pause: ShareGroup has no pause API; the share/pause cell holds acquired records without acknowledge for pause_ms, then accepts.
share_analogues.max_poll_expiry: ShareGroup does not leave on max.poll.interval.ms; the share/max_poll_expiry cell uses share lock timeout / redelivery as the distinct budget.

share_produce: Broker default share.auto.offset.reset is latest. Share cells create the topic, join and arm a fetch, then produce so the first ShareFetch is not at log-end. share/member_loss produces after the surviving member rejoins so newly assigned partitions are not initialized at log-end.

3.9.1.classic: supported; not scheduled in this 4.1.0 job
3.9.1.cooperative: supported; not scheduled in this 4.1.0 job
3.9.1.share: unsupported: KIP-932 share groups require Kafka 4.x
